BEP 11: Peer Exchange (PEX).

Allows peers to exchange peer lists without contacting the tracker. Uses the extension protocol (BEP 10) with extension name "ut_pex".

Combine two flag sets.Intersect two flag sets.Invert the current flag set.Compare two values for equality.Return the human-readable representation of this value.
